The person mixes the meat and marinade ingredients inside the bowl with a gloved hand.

A person prepares a sauce in a glass bowl, adding ingredients and pouring a dark liquid from a bottle.
A person uses a wire mesh skimmer to place pieces of raw meat into a pot of hot oil to fry.
A close-up shows a glass bowl containing cooked meat pieces while a spoon stirs the contents.
